presets.label: Straight sill / glazing line
presets.traceRule: Trace the explicit visible glazing/sill segment exactly as drawn on the source plan.

presets.label: Projected bay — primary front face
presets.traceRule: Recognize the whole projected bay module, then trace only its primary outward viewing face. Do not trace the whole structural outline.

presets.label: Corner bay — primary viewing face
presets.traceRule: For an angled/corner bay, identify the room-facing bay module and trace the primary outward viewing face. Preserve secondary faces separately only when they materially represent another view direction.

presets.label: Multi-face bay window
presets.traceRule: Record each meaningful glazing face as a separate source segment when distinct view directions are required. Do not collapse the entire bay perimeter into one segment.

presets.label: Full-height glazing / picture window
presets.traceRule: Trace the glazing facade segment shown by the plan; do not substitute the room boundary or balcony edge.

presets.label: Balcony door / glazed opening
presets.traceRule: Trace the actual glazed opening / door line used for the view direction, not the balcony outer parapet.

presets.label: Negative — ledge / sill projection only
presets.traceRule: This pattern is NOT sufficient evidence of a window. Do not publish a window from the projection alone unless another approved sample/source identifies the actual glazing face.

presets.label: Negative — AC platform
presets.traceRule: Do not classify AC platforms or service ledges as windows.

presets.label: Negative — structural projection
presets.traceRule: Do not classify a generic structural projection as glazing without source evidence.

presets.label: Custom / other
presets.traceRule: Use the user note and sample image as semantic guidance. Do not copy sample coordinates to target plans.
